# Barcelona.cat

> > Official Barcelona City Council website providing municipal services, cultural activities, and practical information for residents and visitors across all city districts.

Barcelona.cat serves as the primary digital gateway to Barcelona's municipal government (Ajuntament de Barcelona/Ayuntamiento de Barcelona), offering comprehensive information about city services, public facilities, events, and administrative procedures. The site covers all ten districts including Sant Martí, Ciutat Vella, Eixample, Sarrià-Sant Gervasi, Nou Barris, and Sant Andreu, with special emphasis on accessibility, family services, and sustainable urban living.

## Key Topics

- Barcelona City Council / Ajuntament de Barcelona
- Municipal districts (Sant Martí, Ciutat Vella, Eixample, Sarrià-Sant Gervasi, Nou Barris, Sant Andreu)
- TMB (Barcelona public transport)
- Accessible facilities and accessibility services
- Municipal markets and sustainable commerce
- Sports facilities and physical activities
- Smoke-free beaches and environmental health
- Catalan National Day (La Diada)
- Parks and gardens (Ciutadella, Montjuïc, Joan Miró)
- Family services and children's activities
- La Ciutadella del Coneixement (knowledge district)
- Barcelona beaches (Mar Bella, Nova Mar Bella)
- Sustainable food and local commerce
- Cultural events and festivals
- Emergency and utility services

## Living in Barcelona

- [Teléfonos de utilidad](https://www.barcelona.cat/es/vivir-en-bcn/telefonos-de-utilidad): Emergency and utility phone numbers including CatSalut and Guardia Civil
- [Accessibilitat](https://www.barcelona.cat/ca/viure-a-bcn/amb-accessibilitat): Accessibility services: transport, housing, and employment for mobility needs
- [Niños y niñas](https://www.barcelona.cat/es/vivir-en-bcn/con-ninos-y-ninas): Family activities, health, and education services for children in Barcelona
- [Children's Leisure](https://www.barcelona.cat/en/living-in-bcn/with-children/leisure): Kids activities: museums, libraries, IMEB play centres, and family programs
- [Hagamos mercado](https://www.barcelona.cat/es/vivir-en-bcn/vive-el-mercado): Interactive map of Barcelona municipal markets with products and activities

## Activities and Events

- [Summer 2025](https://www.barcelona.cat/en/what-to-do-in-bcn/summer): Summer activities: beaches, pools, Festa Majors, museums, and outdoor films
- [Ponte en forma](https://www.barcelona.cat/es/que-hacer-en-bcn/ponte-en-forma): Sports agenda with events, park routes, and municipal facilities in BCN
- [Agenda nens i nenes](https://www.barcelona.cat/ca/viure-a-bcn/amb-nens-i-nenes/agenda): Children's events calendar: theater, workshops, festivals at Liceu & Tibidabo

## Beaches and Recreation

- [Mar Bella beach](https://www.barcelona.cat/en/what-to-do-in-bcn/bathing-and-beaches/mar-bella-beach): Sant Martí beach with nudist zone, volleyball, nautical base, and play area
- [Nova Mar Bella beach](https://www.barcelona.cat/en/what-to-do-in-bcn/bathing-and-beaches/nova-mar-bella-beach): Quiet Sant Martí beach with volleyball, Blue Flag, and accessible facilities
- [Playas sin humo](https://www.barcelona.cat/es/que-hacer-en-bcn/banos-y-playas/playas-sin-humo): Smoke-free beaches policy and environmental health regulations in BCN
- [Actividades deportivas organizadas con ánimo de lucro](https://www.barcelona.cat/es/que-hacer-en-bcn/banos-y-playas/actividades-deportivas-organizadas-con-animo-de-lucro): Regulations for commercial sports activities on Barcelona beaches

## Parks and Urban Spaces

- [Parks opening hours](https://www.barcelona.cat/en/what-to-do-in-bcn/parks-and-gardens/opening-hours): Opening times for Barcelona parks including Ciutadella and Joan Miró
- [How to get to Montjuïc Park and get around](https://www.barcelona.cat/en/what-to-do-in-bcn/montjuic-park/how-get-and-around-park): Transport guide: metro, bus, funicular access to Montjuïc from Poble-sec
- [La transformación del parque](https://www.barcelona.cat/es/conocebcn/ciutadelladelconocimiento/la-transformacion-del-parque): Ciutadella park renewal: infrastructure, accessibility, and cultural venues

## Knowledge and Culture

- [La Barcelona contemporània](https://www.barcelona.cat/ca/coneixbcn/la-historia/la-barcelona-contemporania): 20th-21st century Barcelona history: Civil War, industrialization, democracy
- [Mercat del Peix](https://www.barcelona.cat/ca/coneixbcn/la-ciutadella-del-coneixement/mercat-del-peix): New UPF research complex for biomedicine and biodiversity at Mercat del Peix

## Administrative Services

- [Oficines de tramitació del DNI i passaport](https://www.barcelona.cat/ca/que-pots-fer-a-bcn/estiu/oficines-de-tramitacio-del-dni-i-passaport): DNI and passport processing offices across Barcelona districts

## Optional

- [Transporte público Diada 2023](https://www.barcelona.cat/es/vivir-en-bcn/diada/transportes-publicos-durante-la-diada-2023): Public transport changes for Catalan National Day 2023 (metro, bus, train)
- [Public transport Diada 2022](https://www.barcelona.cat/en/living-in-bcn/catalan-national-day-2019/public-transport-11-september-2022-catalan-national-day): TMB metro and bus service disruptions for Catalan National Day 2022
